entities.summary: Pargev Vardanian, known professionally as Parg, is an Armenian singer and songwriter based in Yerevan. Parg released his debut single, "Ginin u grely", in 2021. He represented Armenia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025 with the song "Survivor".
